idea-plugin.name: YARA Language Support
idea-plugin.description:
Provides syntax highlighting for YARA rule files (.yar, .yara) in IntelliJ IDEA.

Features:
  • Syntax highlighting for YARA keywords, strings, comments, variables, and more
  • Recognition of .yar and .yara file extensions
  • Support for all YARA language constructs including hex strings, regex patterns, and section headers
